_read_me: Automatic headlines from drug checking services (SOP section 9a, approved by Sid 28 Oct 2026). Only switch a source on (enabled: true) with approval from Sid or Jimmy AND the service's written agreement. We only ever show their headline, date, name and link. Only headlines from the last 30 days show (max_age_days). The list hides itself if it hasn't updated for 4 days.
_sources_help: type: rss (default) or checkit. lang_code is the two-letter language of the headlines (en, es, de). language is shown to visitors when it isn't English.
